title: Corrective fix for B-3462bda9: Shared feature review
description:
Blocked reason: Finding 1 (Medium — blocker): In ShoppingListDetailView.swift:83, the guard `totalCount == 0` unconditionally shows EmptyStateView regardless of whether the document has notes. When a list has non-empty notes and zero items, both edit entry points disappear: the toolbar "Edit notes" item is only shown when `document.notes.isEmpty` (line 112), and the notes header section lives inside `listContent` which is never rendered. The user has no UI path to view or edit their notes until they add an item back. Fix: change the condition from `totalCount == 0` to `totalCount == 0 && notesLines.isEmpty` (or more broadly `document.notes.isEmpty && document.meals.isEmpty && totalCount == 0`).

Remaining work: One bug requires a fix in ShoppingListDetailView.swift before the feature can merge.

handoff_summary.completed: Changed `else if totalCount == 0` to `else if totalCount == 0 && notesLines.isEmpty && document.meals.isEmpty` at ShoppingListDetailView.swift:83. When a list has non-empty notes or meals and zero items, `listContent` now renders, making both the inline ShoppingListHeaderView `onEdit` callback and the toolbar "Edit notes" entry point reachable.
handoff_summary.remaining: None for this corrective bead. The parent bead B-3462bda9 can be retried — the blocker finding is resolved. The tester agent should run the EditNotesFlowTests suite to confirm the fix holds.
handoff_summary.risks: Minimal. Change is a single boolean expression addition. Both `notesLines` and `document.meals` are already computed properties in scope. No new state, no structural change.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should run EditNotesFlowTests (CookbookAppTests/EditNotesFlowTests.swift) and the full shopping list suite to verify the fix. Parent bead B-3462bda9 can be retried after tests pass.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Low. Only ShoppingListDetailView.swift was touched and this is the sole active worktree for feature root B-e5f14e6e. xcodegen must be re-run after takt merge per CLAUDE.md.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used the broader three-condition guard (`totalCount == 0 && notesLines.isEmpty && document.meals.isEmpty`) rather than the narrower two-condition variant (`totalCount == 0 && notesLines.isEmpty`) so that lists with meals but no notes also render `listContent` rather than `EmptyStateView`.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Existing EditNotesFlowTests.swift covers the notes-with-no-items scenario. No new tests required for this minimal corrective fix.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The toolbar "Edit notes" menu item (line 112) is intentionally shown only when `document.notes.isEmpty` — when notes exist, editing is done via the inline ShoppingListHeaderView onEdit callback. This is correct behavior and was not changed.

conflict_risks: Low. Only ShoppingListDetailView.swift was touched and this is the sole active worktree for feature root B-e5f14e6e. xcodegen must be re-run after takt merge per CLAUDE.md.
